$comment: Directory of every contract and protocol wallet the app talks to, rendered by components/admin/contract-directory.tsx. Metadata only — the addresses themselves stay in env and are resolved through lib/contract-addresses.ts, because Next.js inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* by matching the literal expression and cannot read one through a computed key.
